title: still present since round 4: demo mark-all-read unread_count pin is still vacuous — the optimistic unread_count: 0 fix is revert-green
evidence: demo_flow_test.gleam:593-604: `pub fn demo_mark_all_read_mutates_store_test() { let m = demo_model() let #(after, _) = client.update(m, msg.UserClickedMarkAllRead) let store = should_be_some_store(after.demo_store) let #(notifications, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store) list.length(notifications) |> should.equal(2) unread |> should.equal(0) after.unread_count |> should.equal(0) }` — demo_model() builds on model.initial(), whose field list contains `unread_count: 0,` (model.gleam:695). The r5 code fix landed in demo_update.gleam:571-573: `#(Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next), unread_count: 0), eff)` but the model starts at 0, so deleting that fix keeps `after.unread_count == 0` and the pin green.
detail: The W11 optimistic badge fix has no effective pin — reverting unread_count: 0 in the demo dispatch stays green, exactly the vacuity r4 flagged.
recommended_fix: Start the pin from a non-zero badge: set unread_count: 2 on the model before dispatching UserClickedMarkAllRead, then assert 0.
